title: 华中科技大学理工科硕士学位论文格式规则模型

template.file: references/华中科技大学硕士学位论文参考模板.docx

source_priority.name: explicit_template_prose
source_priority.policy: Highest priority; mandatory wording is enforced and advisory wording is normally WARNING.

source_priority.name: identifiable_correct_example
source_priority.policy: Use when prose is silent; do not override Level 1.

source_priority.name: word_style_or_ooxml
source_priority.policy: Use as implementation evidence and fallback, accounting for inheritance and direct formatting.

source_priority.name: documented_inference
source_priority.policy: Never present as an explicit university requirement.

severity_definitions.ERROR: 错误：明确违反学校模板的强制要求，或 DOCX 结构无效。
severity_definitions.WARNING: 警告：建议性要求、疑似问题、边界情况或规则来源存在冲突。
severity_definitions.MANUAL_REVIEW: 人工复核：必须结合渲染效果、语义、学术内容或上下文判断。
severity_definitions.PASS: 通过：已完成检查且符合要求。

automation_levels.AUTOMATIC: 自动检查：可以从 DOCX/OOXML 稳定、确定地判断。
automation_levels.SEMI_AUTOMATIC: 半自动检查：程序能够定位候选问题，但需要上下文或人工确认。
automation_levels.MANUAL_REVIEW: 人工检查：不能仅凭 OOXML 得出可靠结论。

notes: 中文、英文/数字和复杂文字字体必须分别解析。
不能把样式名称直接当作最终有效格式。
页脚可能通过制表位实现视觉居中，不能只读取段落对齐属性。

conflicts.higher_priority_evidence: P124 explicitly requires 四号 (14 pt) and fixed 25 pt line spacing.
conflicts.lower_priority_evidence: Built-in TOC 1 and TOC 2 styles in the template are stored as 10 pt.
conflicts.resolution: Check 14 pt and fixed 25 pt as Level 1; retain the 10 pt style fact as evidence and warn when explaining the template.
conflicts.evidence_zh: 模板正文要求四号（14 磅）、固定值 25 磅；模板 TOC 1/TOC 2 样式实际保存为 10 磅。
conflicts.resolution_zh: 执行一级来源的 14 磅和固定值 25 磅；保留 10 磅样式事实并在报告中说明。

conflicts.higher_priority_evidence: The explicit formula instructions use chapter-based numbering with an example described as 2-3.
conflicts.resolution: Enforce chapter-based numbering; flag delimiter and parentheses as WARNING/MANUAL_REVIEW until the school clarifies.
conflicts.evidence_zh: 文字说明采用按章编号并出现“2-3”，可见示例为“(2.1)”。
conflicts.resolution_zh: 必须按章连续编号；优先接受“(2-3)”，点号、短横线和圆括号差异按警告或人工复核处理。

conflicts.higher_priority_evidence: P131 says 楷体、小二 (18 pt).
conflicts.lower_priority_evidence: The actual header XML uses 华文楷体, 16.5 pt, red, with red VML rules.
conflicts.resolution: Use 楷体 18 pt for mandatory font/size; model red text and red rules as Level 2/3 template appearance and surface the discrepancy.
conflicts.evidence_zh: 正文明确写明楷体、小二（18 磅），实际页眉 XML 为华文楷体、16.5 磅、红色并带红色双线。
conflicts.resolution_zh: 字体和字号执行一级文字要求；红色文字和双线作为模板外观要求检查，同时披露冲突。

conflicts.higher_priority_evidence: The visible example places page numbers at the horizontal center.
conflicts.lower_priority_evidence: The Footer paragraph style is left-aligned; the PAGE field is centered by tab stops.
conflicts.resolution: Determine effective visual centering from tab stops and field position, not w:jc alone.
conflicts.evidence_zh: 页码视觉居中，但 Footer 样式为左对齐，实际通过制表位定位。
conflicts.resolution_zh: 按最终有效位置判断居中，不能只检查段落的 w:jc 属性。
